answer_1.quote: We generate the entire dataset, rather than just the labels... using GPT3 to extend the dataset... We extended the negation dataset using two methods ... using GPT3... The role reversal dataset was also generated by GPT3.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic sentence pairs (affirmative and negated) for negation probing and role-reversal sentences

answer_2.quote: After generating samples from GPT3, the dataset was manually cleaned to filter out poorly generated examples... Human evaluation was performed on 100 samples... Inter‑annotator agreement was computed using Cohen's kappa.

answer_4.quote: We validated our new datasets through human evaluation. For this, we randomly selected 100 samples from each of the extended datasets. Each of these sentences was presented to two annotators, who were asked to complete the sentences with a one-word response.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to complete each sentence with a single word (cloze test) without punctuation or extra spaces.
